title: ROSE GARDEN
credits: Based on an original concept by Akshat Agarwal
Reimagined and expanded as Rose Garden

scenes.intent: An enormous ivory stroke and a searching vine: architecture before alphabet.
scenes.camera: Track up the real coil, close and diagonal; roll -24 to -10 degrees. Never reveal a word.
scenes.transition: Match the coil's closing curve to the lip of a petal.
scenes.sound: Close dry friction, low air, one thorn tick. Pulse enters without a kick.

scenes.intent: One bloom becomes a monumental piece of folded crimson geometry.
scenes.camera: Pull from petal crop to the full rose, then brake. Slight clockwise composition roll.
scenes.transition: Black wing cuts across the crimson spiral.
scenes.sound: A bowed fifth opens; reverse breath becomes a soft low pulse.

scenes.intent: Butterfly geometry interrupts the flower: beautiful, intimate, slightly threatening.
scenes.camera: Wing macro cut into a tilted rose portrait; hold its landing. No wide reveal.
scenes.transition: Carry the wingbeat's contraction into the bite.
scenes.sound: Two delicate wing snaps; drums disappear at contact.

scenes.intent: A real bead hangs, releases, and falls toward a huge white serif.
scenes.camera: Short controlled descent, deliberate empty gap, sharp catch at impact.
scenes.transition: Native impact is the hard edit into the liquid surface.
scenes.sound: Near silence; close wet contact at 10, low impact at 12.5.

scenes.intent: Fluid draws a meandering red inscription inside the glyph.
scenes.camera: Extreme liquid/stroke crop. Follow the native run rather than showing a material comparison.
scenes.transition: A hooked liquid curve matches a wind-bent cane.
scenes.sound: Small viscous ticks become a granular rhythm; first full bass pulse.

scenes.intent: The native wind front bends the garden and strips petals across the lens.
scenes.camera: Counter-track the wind, then whip with it. Wide floral fragments, diagonal crops, a rose macro insert.
scenes.transition: A flying petal crosses the cut to the same silhouette in black on bone.
scenes.sound: Pulse breaks into doubled percussion; one tearing air hit, stereo petal passes.

scenes.intent: A severe bone-white interruption: velvet-black roses read like cut silhouettes.
scenes.camera: Keep the matched rose position; decelerate the roll. One graphic medium crop.
scenes.transition: Same garden, same seeds; the native death wave takes over.
scenes.sound: A dry crack, high harmonics stripped out; heartbeat left exposed.

scenes.intent: Blooms bow, leaves curl and fall, life drains down the planted structure.
scenes.camera: Recede only far enough to see several connected strokes; keep the name unresolved.
scenes.transition: Hold on the last bare hooked cane, no dissolve.
scenes.sound: Descending string rasp, brittle petal ticks; hard stop at 25.

scenes.intent: A bare thorn and ash cane. Absence has real screen time.
scenes.camera: One close diagonal composition, almost still. This is the film's deliberate breath.
scenes.transition: Hard cut from the hook to a newborn crimson curve in matching screen position.
scenes.sound: 2.5 seconds of near silence with a single thin room tone.

scenes.intent: The real regrowth phase races through the same letter skeleton, reopening the garden.
scenes.camera: Climb from root to bloom; accelerate as clusters open. A large partial letter anchors the scale.
scenes.transition: Return's rising curve becomes a burst of fast rose/coil/wing cuts.
scenes.sound: Reverse bloom rush; wider minor harmony with an added sixth, pulse returns in half time then doubles.

scenes.intent: A final rhythmic collision of petal, thorn, wing and letter; fragments finally cohere.
scenes.camera: Four short compositions at 32.5, 33.125, 33.75 and 34.375; land on the portrait at 35.
scenes.transition: Velocity cuts to complete stillness and a readable planted identity.
scenes.sound: Four sharply voiced accents; last one ends the percussion.

scenes.intent: ROSE GARDEN, fully grown. Earned stillness, generous negative space, exact attribution.
scenes.camera: A centered planted name held for five seconds. Attribution enters at 36.25 and stays to the end.
scenes.transition: End on the living portrait without an extra logo or tagline.
scenes.sound: One warm bell over a suspended chord; decay to silence.
